old_value: {"id":"JMAP-ew00","title":"object-uri spec: wording inconsistencies found building jmap-object-uri","description":"Mark's call (jmap-chat-spec). 1) chat-federation-00 strip rule says 'JMAP object URI (scheme jmap)' but object-uri-00 reserves jmap:// forms that are not object URIs: say 'a jmap URI'. 2) chat-00 link span 'MUST NOT be a JMAP object URI' leaves jmap:// allowed. 3) chat-tasks-00 registers tasklist/task but no IETF doc registers Task/TaskList in the RFC 9404 Data Types registry, so they fail object-uri's expert check. 4) graph-projection-00 claims all RFC 8621/9610 types but omits VacationResponse. 5) type-name has no length limit (ids capped at 255).","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-11-20T07:40:22.037788406Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-11-20T07:40:22.037788406Z"}
